items.brief: Transcript audit 2026-10-07 (session 56d2e4d167): user asked "รถ KK ทะเบียนอะไร" twice at 13:41; memory search had ALREADY returned the answer (plate 5ขว 6249 in hits)… A worker session is on it — nothing needed unless it posts a question.
Ada should review and take action on the board. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed yet.

Implement the ada_look voice tool in ada-pi: GET the ada-ha-scenario-reports/eye:latest MDDB doc, answer "what do you see" with class counts + source + freshness. Read-only; never triggers actions on detections (confirm-gate model preserved).

When you ask Ada about gold, exchange rates, or Thai stocks she often guesses instead of looking up real numbers. The plan is a lookup tool backed by the trade database — waiting in the backlog, no action needed.

Ground Ansible as the declared-state/verification layer for ada-ocb: two read-only playbooks (surface audit + contract verify) plus an ocb_pane inventory group. The npm upgrade path already exists and stays the executor.

Follow-up to AUD-0014. Build an approval-gated ada-ocb-upgrade.yml that starts idc02's existing openchamber-update.service (never reimplements npm i -g), then runs ada-ocb-verify.yml. Blocked on explicit same-session production-write approval.
Verify an actual fresh OpenChamber conversation uses injected Ada instructions and same-session ada-control MCP tools; separate from ADA-0173 direct-bridge verification.
Add bounded exact SSOT search to OpenChamber and update the canonical tool registry; reuse existing SSOT sources instead of creating a duplicate.
Make the OpenCode-Ada command fix durable and callable from both Ada and Devin without arbitrary repo writes.
Deploy a protected read-only Ada/OpenCode control-plane surface on idc02 and insert it immediately after Board in the ada-ha chaba-admin dashboard.
Evaluate Ada as an independent review-plane QA/QC stage for OpenCode-generated result bundles. Ada reviews; she does not execute or approve deployment.

Audit 2026-10-09: on CalendarAuthError the model re-issued tasks action=list ~11 times in 9s (16:31:03–16:31:12 ICT) and calendar_read 5 times in 9s (16:32:09–16:32:18). Burns quota, adds dead air, never succeeds.
Create ansible/ scaffold (inventory of tony-omen, tony-dell, idc02, idc03 + portable/macos groups) verbatim from spec, then ansible ping + site.yml --check --diff. Dry-run only.
Add a parallel read-only ansible playbook that probes ssot.host-software.yml capabilities and writes per-host benchmark reports.

Evaluate and wire an AWX/AAP front end onto the existing dispatch queue so job submission is RBAC-controlled and can require approval before dispatch. Done when a decision record and, if adopted, a gated playbook path exist without breaking the current scheduler.
Most review/decide asks get a one-word Tony answer. Queued — a worker session will pick it up; no action needed.
Idea: give every small node its own tiny AI model that gets smarter when the nodes connect. It's a vision card sitting in the backlog — no action needed yet.

Add Cline Kanban after the Board tab without a second browser key prompt; reuse Cloudflare Access SSO through a server-side, tailnet-only proxy. Confirm the correct HA instance before mutating the dashboard.
A scheduled report-page job ('ada-debug-report') is stale. Re-run it or check the generator — details in the note.

Make Colab the one operator surface for DevNest, voice/video, eval and GPU jobs: one canonical notebook, clear instructions, safe runtime/session preflight, and standard cache-warmup scheduling.
Adds the two development Home Assistant sites to the same public-edge setup the live ones already use. Queued — a worker session will pick it up; no action needed.
All the pieces to locate a lost device already exist — this adds one place that pulls them together. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed.
Fix the MacBook dispatch rejection by making model IDs executor-aware; do not pass litellm/* aliases into `devin --model` or silently enable paid frontier.
Make DevNest advance at the same pace as the rest of Chaba: every delegated job must be specified, routed, isolated, verified, audited, measured, and fed back into JEV/skills/education.
Run three small verified jobs through OpenCode + Gemini Flash Lite and compare against matched Devin historical work.
Add a tiny deterministic helper plus unit test through OpenCode Flash Lite.
Run a supervised OpenCode scenario that assesses a declared target host load without changing anything.
Review and, only after Ada approval and Tony confirmation, promote the protected WP-4010 news story to the public News hierarchy.
Only true agent-first IDE on the list; free weekly quota. Blocked on Tony: needs his Google login.
Compare gemini-4-hydrogen/neon via the Interactions API against the current 3.x stateless text path on a small multi-turn tool-and-recall task set; measure task accuracy, token growth and latency.
Tracker card that maps all the God's-Eye-View work and the order to do it in. For orientation — no action needed.
Verifies the new idc02 runner can claim, run, merge, and auto-close a dispatch card. Nothing needed from you — it should drain itself; flag me only if it stalls.
Run a matched, gated evaluation of OpenCode and Cline building a disposable Jack LLM stack on a safe host.
Evaluate a bounded planner that proposes additional real task packages from existing evidence without allowing KK-Mac to mutate or recursively feed its own queue.
Make Omen local Jev decision services and OpenRouter free/paid tiers dependable optional lanes with health, quota, cost, verifier, and fallback gates.
Run one supervised explicit kk_mac_local executor job on tony-dell runner against KK-Mac qwen3:8b.
Run the one bounded local-Qwen summary probe already approved on OPS-0978, using the newly authorized idc03 SSH key; do not enable automatic KK-Mac routing.

mn-ha voice session loses its Gemini upstream (idle-kill 1008/1011) while the client ws stays open — pump never sees the death, is_stalled only arms on a pending user turn, send_audio errors are suppressed, deferred notifies log into the corpse every ~10s. User: permanent silence = no voice out.
An experiment to shrink the memory database's vectors so lookups get cheaper; it's now testable on the spare node. Sitting in the backlog — no action needed.
A 178MB speech model that transcribes on plain CPU at ~100x real time — free local transcripts for our non-Thai audio instead of burning Gemini tokens. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed.
Open-source models can now clone a Thai voice from a ~15s clip — usable for the YouTube dub pipeline and a consistent Ada voice. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed.
An experiment to run object detection on the home camera feeds. Sitting in the backlog — no action needed.
Close the four verification gaps recorded on Education:LLM Providers and its five leaf pages before any provider leg is promoted in the idc03 gateway chains.
Umbrella card for turning raw logs into a readable digest — detection and daily reports are already live. It tracks the remaining lanes; no action needed.
The log shipper reads logs faster than it sends them, so some hosts fall days behind. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed yet.
One memory-database replica quietly stops copying new data while still looking connected — no errors anywhere. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed yet.
Exploring whether many small AI models working together beat one big one. Work is in progress — nothing needed unless a question appears on the card.
A page that shows a camera feed and draws object labels on it right in the browser, castable to the TV. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed.

Measure whether the Drive-store improvements (ADA-0806, 10-23/24) actually pay. Parses queue/run-*.out.log + done markers + heartbeat to emit per-session metrics: wall_min, gpu_min (from gpu% in DONE lines), idle_min, packs_done, failures, cold_start_min, and estimated $/pack.

The chaba-nest hub page shows "no metrics" on every lane, so the decisions-Δ and escalation-% columns are dead. The metrics module is already written (scripts/jev/lane_metrics.py) — the openjev lane servers just haven't adopted it. Expected action: dispatch it; nothing needed from you.
The small-model training loop that already turned a weak model into a good one needs an owner to keep improving it. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed.
Evaluate whether OpenChamber Session Goals can drive a bounded Adobe Stock reuse review to a verifiable stopping condition.
Make Adobe Stock reuse results useful in OpenChamber by showing source-bound image previews and safe asset selection without uploading or mutating Adobe Stock.
We detect failures well but respond ad-hoc — every alert should know its severity, playbook, and whether a machine may fix it. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed.
Remove the accidental global ForceCommand internal-sftp on mn01 so shell, Ansible and the canary rerun work again.
The commit-time SSOT check fails on warnings that were already filed as known debt, which blocks merges. Plan: keep a baseline and fail only on new warnings. In the backlog — no action needed.
